info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Analysis API
info.description: The Contribution Analysis API provides insights into the financial performance of various banking products. By analyzing contributions from different services, it helps financial analysts and business strategists identify trends and make data-driven decisions. This API is designed for use by banking professionals seeking to optimize their product offerings and enhance profitability. Users can retrieve detailed analysis based on specified parameters to facilitate informed decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve contribution analysis details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific contribution analysis identified by its unique ID. It provides insights into the contribution metrics, allowing businesses to effectively evaluate performance and make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve contribution analysis data for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It allows the user to specify parameters that will refine the data returned based on the requirements of the analysis.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested contribution analysis data.

GetContributionAnalysisByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the contribution analysis operation. It expects a string value.

GetContributionAnalysisByIdResponse_200.title: Contribution Analysis Response

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that the request was sent to. Use this header to track which endpoint the response corresponds to.

X-Runtime-App.description: Indicates the application runtime that processed the request. This helps in identifying the environment or deployment context.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication format, which expects a token (JWT - JSON Web Token) to be included in the Authorization header of HTTP requests. The token should be securely managed and should grant access to protected resources.
